**Why this fits Nopeat rather than being a separate tool**

This project fuses bundler graphs with source maps and refuses to publish a
number it cannot measure. Requests that need a new measurement target, a new
artifact type, or a new size dimension belong here; requests for a general
purpose build tool do not.

**Would you be willing to implement it?**

A PR that ships with a measurement is worth ten feature requests.
